item.blackmark.black_mark.tooltip.1: It has no shell. This is only the part that agreed to be seen.
item.blackmark.black_mark.tooltip.2: It will leave when it decides to.
curse.blackmark.slot_devourer.onset: Something drags in your pack. The cloth blackens where the mark settled.
curse.blackmark.dementia.onset: The names of things have gone strange. You knew them yesterday.
curse.blackmark.blight.onset: Salt rot on your tongue. Wounds will not close on their own now.
curse.blackmark.eternal_wounds.onset: An old pain has woken. It will not sleep again.
message.blackmark.marked.self: Something cold has settled on you, and it does not come off.
message.blackmark.marked.broadcast: Fog is coming off the shore. Someone was chosen tonight.
message.blackmark.marked.broadcast_named: Fog is coming off the shore. The mark has settled on %s.
message.blackmark.freed.self: It dissolved into the air. For the first time in a long while, you are alone.
message.blackmark.freed.broadcast: The fog over the shore has thinned. The debt is paid.
message.blackmark.defy.drop.1: You opened your hand. It stayed.
message.blackmark.defy.drop.2: Your hand is empty. The weight is not.
message.blackmark.defy.drop.3: The mark does not fall. There is nowhere for it to fall.
message.blackmark.defy.drop.4: You threw it away. It got back before you did.
message.blackmark.defy.stash.2: There is nowhere to hide it. It knows the way back.
message.blackmark.defy.stash.3: You left it in there. It has been here the whole time.
message.blackmark.defy.stash.4: Another man's box could not hold it.
message.blackmark.defy.grasp.1: Your fingers passed through and closed on empty air.
message.blackmark.defy.grasp.2: You lifted it, and it ran back down.
message.blackmark.defy.grasp.3: A cold on your palm. Nothing else.
message.blackmark.defy.grasp.4: It gave way. For one heartbeat.
message.blackmark.idle.1: Salt wind. You did not call for it.
message.blackmark.idle.2: Far behind you, someone is saluting.
message.blackmark.slots.devour.1: The cloth of your pack blackened another finger's width.
message.blackmark.slots.devour.2: One more place has become nothing.
message.blackmark.slots.devour.3: The blackness crept further out from the mark.
message.blackmark.slots.devour.4: Nothing goes in there any more.
message.blackmark.dementia.worsen.1: You have forgotten what it is called.
message.blackmark.dementia.worsen.2: Your thoughts tangle, as though they were someone else's.
message.blackmark.dementia.worsen.4: Fog in your head, salty and thick.
message.blackmark.dementia.scramble.1: You did not put that there.
message.blackmark.dementia.scramble.3: Your hand reaches for the wrong thing.
message.blackmark.dementia.scramble.4: You could have sworn it was on the left.
message.blackmark.blight.rot.3: The food spoiled in your hands.
message.blackmark.blight.rot.4: Salt and rot. You cannot eat this.
message.blackmark.wounds.open.1: That one will not close. Not ever.
message.blackmark.wounds.open.2: Something tore inside and did not knit.
message.blackmark.wounds.open.3: The mark took a piece of you.
message.blackmark.wounds.open.4: You are less than you were.
message.blackmark.wake.too_soon: It has not had its fill. Too soon.
message.blackmark.wake.not_night: Not in daylight. The dead are mourned after dark.
message.blackmark.wake.not_coast: Not here. Its place is by the water.
message.blackmark.wake.alone: A wake alone is no wake. %s of %s have gathered.
message.blackmark.wake.no_tribute: Your off hand must hold the tribute: %s.
message.blackmark.wake.dissolved: From his ashes, the mark dissolved into the air.
curse.blackmark.pirate.onset: Someone is speaking with your mouth. You hear yourself and do not know the voice.
message.blackmark.pirate.gold.2: MINE! ALL OF IT, DOWN TO THE LAST COIN!
message.blackmark.pirate.gold.3: IT SHINES! D'YE HEAR ME, IT SHINES!
message.blackmark.pirate.strike_self: Your hand swung on its own. You did not mean it.
message.blackmark.pirate.calm: The haze clears. Your hands are yours again.
message.blackmark.pirate.hoard: Your fingers will not open. It is yours, and that is that.
